description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance Call Out with Effect from June 22, 2022 All the Members of the Armed Forces
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Public Security Ordinance to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action as it invokes statutory powers under existing legislation (Chapter 40) and creates a binding order with legal effect, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
